entry.summary:
At Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora, we are incredibly proud of the collaborative, world-class environments we cultivate for our kaimahi (staff). 

In this video, GynoMum – a former New York City specialist – shares a firsthand look at why international medical professionals choose to build their careers and lives here in Aotearoa New Zealand.

From cutting-edge clinical resources to a deeply embedded cultural philosophy, we strive to build a health system that cares for our communities by first caring for our clinicians.

Learn more about what being an Obstetrician and Gynaecologist with Health New Zealand is like on our website ➡️ healthnz.govt.nz/OG
